name: homestay-website
description: Editorial homestay website with a built-in CMS (Next.js + Payload).

scripts.build: npm run migrate && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" next build
scripts.seed: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_DIRECT_DB=1 payload run src/seed/index.ts
scripts.setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.media:upload: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_DIRECT_DB=1 payload run src/seed/media-to-database.ts
scripts.admin:create: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_DIRECT_DB=1 payload run src/seed/create-admin.ts
